name: Oded
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Read it again. And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren 200,000 women, sons, and daughters, and took also a much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria. To Samaria, that's where Ephraim dwelt. Come on. But a prophet of the Lord was there, whose name was Oded. Listen good. And he went out before the host that came to SAMARIA SAYING SO ODED STOOD BEFORE EPHRAIM AND ALL THE 10 TRIBES. HE STOOD IN THEIR PATH. WHAT DID HE SAY? AND SAID TO THEM, "BEHOLD, because the Lord GOD OF YOUR FATHERS WAS WROTH WITH JUDAH BECAUSE THE LORD GOD OF YOUR FATHERS WAS MAD WITH JUDAH. COME ON. HE HATH delivered them INTO YOUR HAND. THAT'S WHY GOD DELIVERED them into your hand.

A prophet of the Most High named Oded went out before the host that came to Samaria and told them the Most High had delivered Judah into their hand because of His wrath, but they had slain them in a rage that reached up to heaven, and now purposed to keep the children of Judah as bondmen, which is against the law, adding to their own sins.
